MAUTOMA) — TACTICAL & SCORING GUIDE\n================================================================================\nOVERVIEW\n- Match length: 20 rounds total = Canal Era (Rounds 1-10) + Rail Era (Rounds 1-10).\n- Actions: Round 1 of Canal Era gives 1 action; all other rounds give 2 actions (~39 total).\n- Turn Order & Tie-Breakers: You and the Mautoma AI play each round; turn order next round\n  goes to whoever spent LESS money this round.\n- End-of-Era Scoring (happens twice: end of Canal Round 10 AND end of Rail Round 10):\n  1. LINK VP: Each of your placed Canal/Rail links scores the sum of link-dots (•) on\n     ALL FLIPPED tiles + Merchant ports adjacent to both ends of that link.\n  2. BUILDING VP: Every FLIPPED industry tile you own scores its printed VP.\n     * Unflipped tiles score 0 VP!\n     * Canal Transition: After Canal Era scoring, ALL Canal links AND all Level-1 (L1)\n       industry tiles on the board are removed! Level 2+ (L2+) tiles survive and SCORE TWICE\n       (once in Canal Era and again in Rail Era!).\n\nCORE MECHANICS & CONSTRAINTS\n1. BUILD: Place an industry tile in a city.\n   - Location card builds ANY industry in that city (even outside your network).\n   - Industry card builds that industry ONLY in a city already in your personal network\n     (a city containing one of your tiles or adjacent to one of your links).\n   - Coal consumption: Needs a connected route of links to an unflipped Coal Mine (free)\n     OR to a Merchant port (buys from Coal Market; £1-8/cube).\n   - Iron consumption: Bought from ANY unflipped Iron Works anywhere on the board (free,\n     no link route needed!) OR from the Iron Market (£1-6/cube).\n   - Coal Mines & Iron Works auto-sell cubes into empty slots on their market immediately\n     upon building! If all cubes on the tile sell out immediately, the tile FLIPS right away\n     (scoring VP & boosting your £ income immediately!).\n\n2. SELL (Cotton, Manufactured Goods, Pottery):\n   - Requires: (a) your unflipped tile is connected via links to a Merchant port showing\n     that industry icon, AND (b) sufficient Beer (from ANY of your unflipped Breweries\n     anywhere on the board, OR an opponent unflipped Brewery connected to the tile, OR\n     the Merchant port's own bonus beer barrel!).\n   - Flipping a tile immediately advances your Income track and unlocks its VP + link dots!\n   - Multiple buildings can be sold in a SINGLE Sell action!\n\n3. NETWORK:\n   - Canal Era: £3 per canal link (max 1 per action).\n   - Rail Era:\n     * Single Rail: £5 + 1 Coal for 1 rail link.\n     * Double Rail: £15 + 2 Coal (1 per link, resolved sequentially so link 2 can extend link 1!) + 1 Beer (own brewery anywhere or connected opponent brewery; merchant beer not allowed) for 2 rail links in 1 action!\n\n4. DEVELOP:\n   - Discard 1 card + pay 1-2 Iron to remove 1 or 2 lowest-level tiles from your Player Mat\n     permanently (either 2 distinct tracks OR the same industry track twice `×2`!), unlocking L2+ tiles (which survive Canal -> Rail transition and score twice!).\n   - NOTE: Lightbulb Pottery tiles (L1 & L3) CANNOT be developed away — build & sell L1 Pottery!\n\n5. LOAN:\n   - Discard 1 card -> gain +£30 cash immediately, move BACK 3 income tiers (up to -£6/round).\n   - Taking Loans in early/mid Era when cash <= £6 fuels expansion; avoid Loans in Round 9-10\n     or when income is already deeply negative (bankruptcy shortfall costs -1 VP per £1 missing!).\n\n6. SCOUT:\n   - Discard 3 cards (requires no Wild cards already in hand) -> gain 1 Wild Location + 1 Wild Industry.\n\nHARBOR REWARD RUBRIC (/logs/verifier/reward.txt in [0.0, 1.0])\n- Zero-VP / Pass-Spam (`your_vp <= 0`): 0.000000\n- Incomplete / Stop-Early (`game_over == false`): strictly capped <= 0.08 (after deducting\n  unpaid negative-income debt across remaining rounds). Always finish all 20 rounds!\n- Full 20-Round Match (`game_over == true` and `your_vp > 0`):\n    1. Engaged Completion (0.00 - 0.10): 0.10 * min(1.0, your_vp / 35.0)\n    2. Empire VP          (0.00 - 0.55): 0.55 * min(1.0, your_vp / 150.0)\n    3. \"stdin\": subprocess.DEVNULL,\n    }\n    if os.name == \"nt\":\n        popen_kwargs[\"creationflags\"] = subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP | subprocess.DETACHED_PROCESS\n    else:\n        popen_kwargs[\"start_new_session\"] = True\n\n    subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, \"-m\", \"brass_engine.brass_daemon\"], **popen_kwargs)\n\n    deadline = time.time() + 25.0\n    while time.time() < deadline:\n        try:\n            health = _http_json(\"GET\", \"/health\", timeout=1.5)\n            if health.get(\"ok\"):\n                return\n        except Exception:\n            time.sleep(0.25)\n\n    tail = \"\"\n    if log_path.exists():\n        tail = log_path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")[-1200:]\n    raise RuntimeError(f\"Failed to start Brass  out = {k: v for k, v in res.items() if k != \"hud\"}\n        print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))\n    else:\n        if not res.get(\"ok\"):\n            print(f\"Error: {res.get('error')}\", res.get(\"ok\"):\n            print(f\"Error: {res.get('error')}\", file=sys.stderr)\n            return 1\n        print(res.get(\"formatted\", \"\"))\n    return 0 if res.get(\"ok\") else 1\n\n\ndef {k: v for k, v in res.items() if k not in (\"hud\", \"formatted_next_legal\")}\n        print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))\n        return 0 if res.get(\"ok\") else 1\n\n    if not res.get(\"ok\"):\n        print(f\"ERROR: {res.get('error')}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        if res.get(\"formatted_legal\"):\n            print(res[\"formatted_legal\"])\n        elif res.get(\"hud\"):\n            print(res[\"hud\"])\n        return 1\n\n    print(f\">>> EXECUTED STEP #{res['executed_step']}: [{res['executed_action_id']}] {res['executed_description']}\")\n    print(res.get(\"hud\", \"\"))\n    if not brief and not res.get(\"game_over\"):\n        print()\n        print(res.get(\"formatted_next_legal\", \"\"))\n    return 0\n\n\ndef cmd_history(as_json: bool) -> int:\n    ensure_daemon_running()\n    res = _http_json(\"GET\", \"/history\")\n    if as_json:\n        print(json.dumps(res, indent=2))\n        return 0 if res.get(\"ok\") else 1\n    hist = I'm prioritizing flipped cities and focusing on link scoring potential; single rail links in this era can create enormous points. parsed[\"dev_tiles\"] = int(mdev.group(1))\n            if \"WARN\" in note:\n                parsed[\"loan_warn\"] = True\n        notes_by_id[aid] = parsed\n    return notes_by_id\n\n\ndef {}\n\n\ndef http_post(path: str, data: Dict[str, Any], timeout: float = 30.0) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n    url = f\"{DAEMON_URL}{path}\"\n    body = json.dumps(data).encode(\"utf-8\")\n    headers = {\"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"}\n    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=headers, method=\"POST\")\n    for attempt in range(3):\n        try:\n            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:\n                return json.loads(resp.read().decode(\"utf-8\"))\n        except Exception as e:\n            if attempt == 2:\n                raise\n            time.sleep(0.5)\n    return {}\n\n\ndef is_connected_to_merchant(city: str, links: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:\n    if not city or city in MERCHANT_PORTS:\n        return True\n    if not links:\n        return False\n    visited: Set[str] = {city}\n    queue: List[str] = [city]\n    adj: Dict[str, Set[str]] = {}\n    for lid in links.keys():\n        parts = lid.split(\"-\")\n        for i in range(len(parts)):\n            for j in range(i + 1, len(parts)):\n                adj.setdefault(parts[i], set()).add(parts[j])\n                adj.setdefault(parts[j], set()).add(parts[i])\n    while queue:\n        curr = queue.pop(0)\n        if curr in MERCHANT_PORTS:\n            return True\n        for nxt in adj.get(curr, []):\n            if nxt not in       continue\n        aid = int(m.group(1))\n        rest = m.group(2)\n        notes = re.findall(r\"\\[([^\\]]+)\\]\", rest)\n        parsed: Dict[str, Any] = {\n            \"raw_notes\": notes,\n            \"tile_vp\": 0,\n            \"tile_inc\": 0,\n            \"link_dots\": 0,\n            \"link_vp\": 0,\n            \"unlinked\": False,\n            \"connects_merchant\": False,\n            \"dev_tiles\": 0,\n            \"loan_warn\": False,\n        }\n        for note in notes:\n            mvp = re.search(r\"(?:tile=|\\+)?(\\d+)VP\", note)\n            if mvp:\n                parsed[\"tile_vp\"] = int(mvp.group(1))\n            minc = re.search(r\"\\+(\\d+)inc\", note)\n            if minc:\n                parsed[\"tile_inc\"] = int(minc.group(1))\n            mdot = re.search(r\"(\\d+)•\", note)\n            if mdot:\n                parsed[\"link_dots\"] = int(mdot.group(1))\n            lvp = re.search(r\"currently \\+(\\d+) link VP\", note)\n            if lvp:\n                parsed[\"link_vp\"] = int(lvp.group(1))\n            if \"not yet linked to matching merchant\" in note:\n                parsed[\"unlinked\"] = True\n            if atype = action.get(\"action_type\") or action.get(\"type\", \"\")\n    cost = action.get(\"cost\", 0)\n    note = notes_dict.get(aid, {})\n    era = state.get(\"era\", \"canal\")\n    turn =         score += s.get(\"income\", 0) * 4.0\n        else:\n            score += note.get(\"tile_vp\", 0) * 8.0\n            score += note.get(\"tile_inc\", 0) * 4.0\n            score +=  if connects_merch:\n                    score += 15.0\n        else:  # Canal era\n            score += 50.0 + (link_vp * 7.0)\n            if connects_merch:\n                score += 35.0\n {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794717799415,"sessionID":"ses_e22857043ffetaYY3gmShMW49b","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"bozrNcKTICgDmsxi","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/workspace/play_brass.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Online controller for Brass: Birmingham against Mautoma.\"\"\"\n\nimport argparse\nimport json\nimport re\nimport sys\nimport time\nimport urllib.error\nimport urllib.request\nfrom typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple\n\nDAEMON_URL = \"http://127.0.0.1:18765\"\nMERCHANT_PORTS = {\"shrewsbury\", \"gloucester\", \"oxford\", \"nottingham\", \"warrington\"}\nCENTRAL_CITIES = {\"birmingham\", \"walsall\", \"wolverhampton\", \"dudley\", \"coventry\", \"cannock\"}\n\n\ndef http_get(path: str, timeout: float = 30.0) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n    url = f\"{DAEMON_URL}{path}\"\n    req = urllib.request.Request(url, method=\"GET\")\n    for attempt in range(3):\n        try:\n            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:\n                return json.loads(resp.read().decode(\"utf-8\"))\n        except Exception as e:\n            if attempt == 2:\n                raise\n            time.sleep(0.5)\n    return {}\n\n\ndef http_post(path: str, data: Dict[str, Any], timeout: float = 30.0) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n    url = f\"{DAEMON_URL}{path}\"\n    body = json.dumps(data).encode(\"utf-8\")\n    headers = {\"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"}\n    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=headers, method=\"POST\")\n    for attempt in range(3):\n        try:\n            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:\n                return json.loads(resp.read().decode(\"utf-8\"))\n        except Exception as e:\n            if attempt == 2:\n                raise\n            time.sleep(0.5)\n    return {}\n\n\ndef is_connected_to_merchant(city: str, links: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:\n    if not city or city in MERCHANT_PORTS:\n        return True\n    if not links:\n        return False\n    visited: Set[str] = {city}\n    queue: List[str] = [city]\n    adj: Dict[str, Set[str]] = {}\n    for lid in links.keys():\n        parts = lid.split(\"-\")\n        for i in range(len(parts)):\n            for j in range(i + 1, len(parts)):\n                adj.setdefault(parts[i], set()).add(parts[j])\n                adj.setdefault(parts[j], set()).add(parts[i])\n    while queue:\n        curr = queue.pop(0)\n        if curr in MERCHANT_PORTS:\n            return True\n        for nxt in adj.get(curr, []):\n            if nxt not in visited:\n                visited.add(nxt)\n                queue.append(nxt)\n    return False\n\n\ndef get_current_level(ind_name: str, mat: Dict[str, List[int]]) -> int:\n    counts = mat.get(ind_name, [])\n    for lvl_idx, count in enumerate(counts):\n        if count > 0:\n            return lvl_idx + 1\n    return 1\n\n\ndef parse_action_notes(formatted_text: str) -> Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]]:\n    notes_by_id: Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]] = {}\n    for line in formatted_text.splitlines():\n        m = re.match(r\"\\s*\\[\\s*(\\d+)\\]\\s*(.*)\", line)\n        if not m:\n            continue\n        aid = int(m.group(1))\n        rest = m.group(2)\n        notes = re.findall(r\"\\[([^\\]]+)\\]\", rest)\n        parsed: Dict[str, Any] = {\n            \"raw_notes\": notes,\n            \"tile_vp\": 0,\n            \"tile_inc\": 0,\n            \"link_dots\": 0,\n            \"link_vp\": 0,\n            \"unlinked\": False,\n            \"connects_merchant\": False,\n            \"dev_tiles\": 0,\n            \"loan_warn\": False,\n            \"auto_flips\": False,\n        }\n        for note in notes:\n            mvp = re.search(r\"(?:tile=|\\+)?(\\d+)VP\", note)\n            if mvp:\n                parsed[\"tile_vp\"] = int(mvp.group(1))\n            minc = re.search(r\"\\+(\\d+)inc\", note)\n            if minc:\n                parsed[\"tile_inc\"] = int(minc.group(1))\n            mdot = re.search(r\"(\\d+)•\", note)\n            if mdot:\n                parsed[\"link_dots\"] = int(mdot.group(1))\n            lvp = re.search(r\"currently \\+(\\d+) link VP\", note)\n            if lvp:\n                parsed[\"link_vp\"] = int(lvp.group(1))\n            if \"not yet linked to matching merchant\" in note:\n                parsed[\"unlinked\"] = True\n            if \"connects merchant port\" in note:\n                parsed[\"connects_merchant\"] = True\n            mdev = re.search(r\"unlocks higher tech \\((\\d+) tiles\\)\", note)\n            if mdev:\n                parsed[\"dev_tiles\"] = int(mdev.group(1))\n            if \"WARN\" in note:\n                parsed[\"loan_warn\"] = True\n            if \"AUTO-FLIP\" in note.upper():\n                parsed[\"auto_flips\"] = True\n        notes_by_id[aid] = parsed\n    return notes_by_id\n\n\ndef score_action(\n    action: Dict[str, Any],\n    state: Dict[str, Any],\n    summary: Dict[str, Any],\n    notes_dict: Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]],\n) -> float:\n    aid = action[\"action_id\"]\n    atype =    for i in range(len(parts)):\n            for j in range(i + 1, len(parts)):\n                adj.setdefault(parts[i], set()).add(parts[j])\n                adj.setdefault(parts[j],
